decisions.reason: After four years in a niche the firm knows well, the injection unit still costs little to hold through a page and a parts base, and nothing reported shows its value will not be realized, so the option stays open.
Its overlap with A keeps some risk of consolidation, but without evidence of weak results the low holding cost justifies keeping this second injection unit for now.
The automatic airless gun shares components with the core pump range and is cheap to maintain, so keeping it costs little and preserves value.
The manual airless gun is a staple that complements the pump business at minimal cost, so there is no case for abandoning it.
Demand for digital monitoring is growing and the data logger is cheap to hold, so this uncertain but promising option is worth keeping open.
